review.decision: Scope Live to confirmed source and session reset generation
review.notes: Use synthetic pane and transcript reads and mounted RN views; no physical gesture claims.

cases.description: Confirm a mobile reader without losing its native viewport
cases.setup: Freeze and resize the HQ and Detail readers on an observed session.
cases.action: Remove the observation, delay the bound transcript, then confirm either the same or a different SID.
cases.expected: Pending content is concealed. Matching proof keeps the original scroll view, frozen rows and height. A replacement starts folded.

cases.description: Clockless resets retire the prior capture
cases.setup: Freeze a working session with a clear marker in focused and tiled layouts.
cases.action: Read another clear without a timestamp, including an empty transcript. Repeat the new marker and test an ordinary empty read.
cases.expected: A new reset generation retires the old reader. Repetition preserves a reopened reader. Older responses with a populated-to-empty clockless reset also retire once.

cases.description: Expose the reset generation even before the first turn
cases.setup: Serve authorized empty transcript responses with a session reset.
cases.action: Read two different generations with no timestamp and read a normal response.
cases.expected: The header carries a distinct stable reset identity only alongside a reset.
